scientific_integrity: The 2010 Schreiber–Li Appendix contains a specific directed-cycle intermediate-rate example. The claimed all-positive-profile and all-interior-rate strict classification is narrower than a general directed-network theorem but stronger than that example. Possible unlocated matrix-inequality equivalences remain a bibliographic risk.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic linear two-season growth, three sites in a single directed cycle, common lossless movement and reciprocal positive patch multipliers; no nonlinear or stochastic ecological interpretation, and no uniqueness of the interior maximizer.
title: Every partial migration rate increases two-season growth on a directed three-patch cycle
